scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.check: npm run check:strings && npm run check:palette && npm run check:privacy
scripts.shell:ios:sim: tauri ios build --target aarch64-sim --debug && npm run shell:sim:install
scripts.shell:ios:review: tauri ios build --target aarch64-sim --debug --config src-tauri/tauri.review.conf.json && npm run shell:sim:install
scripts.shell:sim:install: xcrun simctl install booted src-tauri/gen/apple/build/arm64-sim/Priveghi.app && xcrun simctl launch booted io.github.horiacy.priveghi
scripts.shell:icons: node scripts/make-icons.mjs shell && tauri icon src-tauri/icons/app-icon.png --ios-color '#110e0b' && rm -rf src-tauri/icons/android
